goal: Navigate to http://www.amazon.in/ to complete the goal: You are testing whether an AI agent can complete a real customer journey on this website. Journey: Find how to exchange a product for a different size: open help, find the returns or exchange policy, read the rules and reach the page where an exchange is requested. Never pay, place an order, create an account, or press a final Send, Submit, Apply, Book or Confirm button. Stop at the first page that asks for payment details or a final confirmation, with that button visible. If a form needs details, type only fake test data: name 'Test Agent', email test@example.com, phone 9999999999. Close cookie banners and popups and continue. Do not sign in. If the site asks you to sign in, stop on that page and report it. Milestones in order: help_opened, returns_found, exchange_rules_read, request_page_reached. Set furthest_milestone to the last one you truly completed. Set outcome to 'success' if you reached every milestone you were allowed to reach, 'partial' if some, otherwise 'failure'. Set blocker to the single main obstacle, or 'none', and explain it in blocker_detail. Fill item_name, item_price, coupon_code, discount and total when they apply.

result.answer:
Exchange Policy Summary:

1. Exchange Eligibility: You may exchange an item for a different size or color (subject to availability on the app/website) or opt for a full refund.
2. Time Limit: Items eligible under the '10 Day Free Returns & Exchange' policy can be exchanged within 10 days of delivery.
3. Conditions: Items must be returned in their original condition with the brand outer box, MRP tags attached, warranty cards, and all original accessories in manufacturer packaging.
4. Policy Types:
   - 7/10 Days Service Centre Replacement: Defective items resolved via brand service centre.
   - 7/10 Days Replacement by Brand: Brand provides technician inspection and resolution.
   - 7/10 Days Replacement: Free replacement within 7/10 days for damaged/defective/wrong items.
   - 10/30 Days Returnable: Free return or replacement within 10/30 days.
   - 10 Day Free Returns & Exchange: Exchange for different size/color (based on availability) or full refund within 10 days.
   - Non-Returnable: No returns except for damaged/defective/wrong items.

Blocker: Amazon.in requires sign-in to access the 'Manage Your Returns' page where exchanges are requested. The sign-in page was reached but no credentials are available, so the request_page_reached milestone could not be completed.
result.blocker_detail: The task successfully completed three milestones: help_opened (visited Amazon.in Help page), returns_found (accessed Returns, Refunds, Replacement section and About Our Return Policies page where exchange rules were read), and exchange_rules_read (the '10 Day Free Returns & Exchange' policy explicitly allows exchanging items for different sizes/colors subject to availability, within 10 days of delivery, with items in original condition). However, the furthest milestone reached is 'returns_found' because when attempting to reach the request page (Manage Your Returns / Start a Return flow), Amazon.in redirected to a sign-in page at https://www.amazon.in/ap/signin which required authentication before any return/exchange request can be initiated. The site requires login to proceed to the exchange request form. Without credentials, the task stops here at the login wall.
